reviews.title: Malware parading as a solution
reviews.text:
This product is not ready for primetime. Basically they’ve released it to the market and if you use it, it will shut down most of your operating capabilities across any of your devices until you manually upload and program it. Pretty much what’s going on here is this company is using its customers to try to finish out its product while it sells a product that they tell the customer is finished. It requires constant and extensive manual tailoring to fix the flaws in its development I got duped into switching to this product by its deceptive marketing product practices.  It is marketed as a solution that functions better and more reliably than things like Norton and other antiviruses and Vpn’s.
It’s marketed as something that you can rely upon to protect your operating systems and data across multiple systems. Basically, however, it requires manual programming to operate across different environments for virtually everything you encounter.  If you want your system to operate without having to spend hours individually uploading websites so that they can get their product adequately deployed to function to meet anything close to it sales pitch, don’t buy this product.
This product is sold as something that allows your system to function and protect you.  In reality, it only protects you if you don’t operate. Hard mess and if you were already duped into buying it like I do go to ftc.gov and file a deceptive marketing complaint against the developer that markets this piece of junk.

reviews.title: Not Worth the Money
reviews.text:
⭐️
Title: Buggy, Unreliable & Not Worth the Money
I used to trust Nord, but the recent software updates have ruined everything. The desktop client constantly freezes, crashes, or drops the VPN connection out of nowhere — often with no warning at all. That defeats the whole purpose of a secure VPN; I can’t tell when my traffic stops being protected.

Switching servers takes forever, many locations refuse to connect, and speeds are painfully slow even on nearby servers. The app hogs system resources, sometimes spiking CPU usage and dragging down my whole computer.

Customer support only sends generic copy-pasted replies and rarely solves real technical problems. What’s worse, the promotional rate jumps sharply once the initial plan renews. Save your cash — there are far more stable VPN options on the market.
⭐️⭐️
I’ve been using Apple products since the iPhone 4s, and this is the first time I’ve ever been this furious with a paid app.

During the 7-day trial, NordVPN worked perfectly. I could connect without any issues and browse the internet smoothly. But the moment I paid $49.99 for a subscription, everything changed. I could no longer connect or even log in. The app just kept displaying “Finding you a faster way to connect.”

As Captain America would say, “I can do this all day.” And apparently, so can your app. The next day, it was STILL trying to connect.

I reported the issue on the App Store, and your response was simply to tell me to reinstall the app. Fine. I followed

However, after installing this app, the Wi-Fi network immediately detected it and blocked my connection. As soon as I removed the app, the Wi-Fi worked normally again.

What’s even more ridiculous is that I had to download and use a free VPN from another provider just to download and set up this VPN. I’ve never seen something so useless.

And that’s not all. When using this VPN, many apps and software programs stop working properly. I constantly have to disconnect the VPN just to use them.

I contacted customer support about these issues, hoping they could help. Instead, I was basically told that these limitations are part of the service and that I would have to live with them until my subscription ends because I agreed to the terms when I purchased the plan.

If you don’t want to waste your money, think carefully before subscribing. Based on my experience, this has been one of the most disappointing VPN services I have ever used.

reviews.title: Disappointing service - got charged after cancellation
reviews.text:
I paid over $30 for NordVPN expecting a reliable service, particularly because I needed it to work in Iran where internet access is heavily filtered. Unfortunately, the application did not work reliably for bypassing the government’s internet restrictions.

What made the experience even more frustrating was seeing people in Iran using much less well-known VPN services costing less than $1 that performed significantly better than NordVPN.

Because NordVPN wasn’t meeting my needs, I cancelled the subscription within a few days and received a confirmation email confirming the cancellation. However, the following month I was still charged.

I contacted NordVPN support and provided the cancellation confirmation email as proof that I had cancelled the service. Despite this, they refused to refund the charge.

For a premium-priced VPN service, I expected much better performance and, at minimum, proper handling of a confirmed cancellation. The combination of poor performance in Iran and being charged after cancellation left me extremely disappointed.

Based on my experience, I cannot recommend NordVPN, especially if your primary reason for using it is accessing the internet from a country with strict government filtering.

reviews.title: Bloated UI on Mac & iOS, broken login required Terminal fix
reviews.text:
NordVPN used to be a lightweight utility, but recent updates made it an over-engineered RAM hog. The UI is particularly sluggish on iOS, even on an iPhone 16 Pro Max. The only upside is that once the VPN is active and paged out of view, the background connection works fine.

On macOS, signing in broke completely. The app forced a prompt for a sketchy domain (napps-1.com) and then hung indefinitely.

Standard reinstalls failed. The fix required manually wiping its local state in Terminal:

rm -rf ~/Library/Containers/com.nordvpn.*

After reinstalling, login finally worked. Nord needs to stop bloating the UI and fix their local caching and auth handoffs.

reviews.title: Problematic
reviews.text: I have used Nord for several years off and on. I’ve recently discovered that several baffling problems with my iPhone have miraculously disappeared when I have disconnected the NordVPN app. It is no good just disconnecting it within the app itself, as you need to go into the iPhone settings and disconnect it there. And you will find that it tries to reconnect itself unless you switch off ‘connect on demand’. Even if you change that, it will sometimes attempt to reconnect itself. However, now that I’ve finally figured out how to get it to fully disengage, I receive emails with all of the photographic attachments, and a work website now allows me to log in, after months of back and forth with tech support to try and find the issue, which was Nord. For most people, iCloud relay will provide enough protection, although VPNs can be useful in certain circumstances. But for me, really not worth the hassle.

reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text: For many years while living in Thailand, I wanted to watch English TV , I always used ExpressVPN , don’t get me wrong they also have their share of problems , mainly a speed problem from time to time , but I was never denied access to the TV channels in the UK that I wanted to watch , now I am in Germany and wanting to watch English TV , so I decided to give NordVPN a try , during playback it is constantly buffering and going slow , sometimes it will just cut the connection , and for getting access to channel 4 movies it just detects that I am not allowed to get it in my country , so all I can say is I am very pleased that this cost me less than 50% of what I would usually pay with express , otherwise I would be really act off , so next time or maybe sooner I will switch back to ExpressVPN , hope this helps .

reviews.title: New version slow and buggy
reviews.text: Hi NordVPN team. I’ve been using NordVPN for almost 10 years and I have been very happy with the iOS app upgrades including new designs. Nonetheless this new version has been very buggy compared with other ones. I usually switch between two regions and it’s very slow switching. Sometimes I’m in one region but shows in another one or keeps flicking between them. Others, it takes a while to change. When connecting, I can see the VPN notification on top right of my phone but the it takes a while to actually show as connected in the app. This leads to me waiting trying to figure out if I’m connected or not each time. Being the region connection one of the main features, I’d expect much better performance.

reviews.title: NordVPN Good, NordProtect Horrible
reviews.text: Only issues I’ve had with VPN over the years has been erroneous app logout (usually due low data signal) which on multiple occasions left my device unprotected without notification, the app update removing ability to automatically connect to a certain server # that works with all my services properly (I don’t want AI to decide and don’t want to connect to a randomly pick a “specific location” server which some of my services identify as in an area over 1k miles away due to weird IP ranges), and marketing push messages…otherwise the service has been good on all devices… but STAY AWAY from NordProtect if you’re a US user. It’s identity monitoring is so secure that when I put my info in it said it found my credit file but locked me out for a month (without partial credit refund) because they weren’t able to verify me (pretty sure the error is on their end)… they have no backup means to verify your identity, such as postal mail or fax like the credit agencies have… thus it’s so safe it can’t be used and just steals your subscription dollars if you don’t immediately cancel.

reviews.title: Still not good.
reviews.text:
Came back to Nord after a while trying other VPNs. I remember why I left. When it works, it’s fine. 

But far too often, it doesn’t work. I’ve tried a few VPNs, and Nord is the only one that regularly freezes or disconnects, then gets stuck trying to reconnect. Manual intervention is a ALWAYS required to regain internet access.

I don’t expect perfect performance at all times, but the regularity that Nord fails is not acceptable. Especially for the full price they charge, which they try to justify with ‘the money helps us improve our product’ which and customer knows is utter nonsense since the product has steadily gotten significantly worse to use over the past few years, regardless of what new features they add.
